edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Ownable constructor, granting the caller privileged ownership.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
msg.sender is used as from and as the allowance spender inside transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whose allowance is consumed in burn.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping as the approving holder in approve.
msg.sender is stored as allowance holder and forwarded as from into receiveApproval.
transferOwnership writes the new value into the owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter is validated and assigned to the owner state variable.
The to parameter indexes the balanceOf mapping when minting in supply.
The amount parameter increases totalSupply in supply.
The from parameter indexes balanceOf for the debit in transferFrom.
The to parameter indexes balanceOf for the credit in transferFrom.
The amount parameter adjusts both balanceOf entries in transferFrom.
The from parameter indexes balanceOf for the destruction in burn.
The amount parameter reduces totalSupply in burn.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
The amount parameter is written into allowance in approve.
The holder parameter indexes nonces and is recovered from the user-supplied signature.
The spender parameter receives the signed allowance inside permit.
The nonce parameter is checked against nonces[holder] for replay protection.
The expiry parameter is compared with now, making permit time-dependent on block.timestamp.
The allowed bool selects between uint256(-1) and 0 for the local amount in permit.
The digest local is consumed by ecrecover inside permit to authenticate the holder.
The computed amount local is written into allowance[holder][spender] in permit.
The local z holds the checked sum result produced by the add helper.
add is invoked to increase balanceOf entries in supply and transferFrom.
add is invoked to increase totalSupply in supply.
sub is invoked to decrease balanceOf entries in transferFrom and burn.
sub is invoked to decrease allowance entries in transferFrom and burn.
sub is invoked to decrease totalSupply inside burn.
transfer dispatches to transferFrom with msg.sender as the from argument.
supply calls add when crediting balanceOf and totalSupply.
transferFrom calls sub on allowance and balances, a path where arithmetic safety matters.
burn calls sub on balanceOf and totalSupply, a path where arithmetic safety matters.
permit executes an unchecked increment of nonces[holder] inside the nonce require.
transferOwnership performs the privileged owner write protected only by onlyOwner.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract, which can re-enter the token.
The external receiver can re-enter transferFrom or burn and consume the freshly written allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowance before the external call, enabling reentrancy exploitation.
The privileged owner write operation mutates the owner state variable directly.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter used only inside transferOwnership to update the owner state variable.
to is a parameter scoped to the supply minting function.
amount is a parameter scoped to the supply minting function.
from is a parameter scoped to transferFrom for balance and allowance debits.
to is a parameter scoped to transferFrom for the balance credit.
amount is a parameter scoped to transferFrom for balance movement.
from is a parameter scoped to burn for balance destruction.
amount is a parameter scoped to burn for supply reduction.
spender is a parameter scoped to approve for the allowance key.
amount is a parameter scoped to approve for the allowance value.
holder is a parameter scoped to permit and bound to the recovered signer.
spender is a parameter scoped to permit for the signed allowance key.
nonce is a parameter scoped to permit for replay protection.
expiry is a parameter scoped to permit and compared with the block timestamp.
allowed is a parameter scoped to permit selecting the granted amount.
digest is a local variable computed and consumed only inside permit.
amount is a local variable derived from allowed and written to allowance inside permit.
z is a local variable holding the checked addition result inside the add helper.
